The '''Narg Starport Souvenir Shop''' was located in the [[Grig Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. Run by [[Sodilayno Smath]], it sold personal items with [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] logos printed on them. Smath ran a sideline business selling information and black market goods.<ref name="Abduction" />
